content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Let's take a closer look at what each option actually offers. Stripe operates in 46 countries, but you're excluded from the 149 countries where they don't operate. PayPal, on the other hand, is notorious for account suspensions, which can hold your funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Gumroad is a popular choice, but it charges a flat fee of 3.5% + 30¢ per sale, and lemon squeezy is not available in many countries. Meanwhile, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), offers a complete commerce solution with automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This stack is built on top of Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, giving you a scalable and secure foundation for your ecommerce business.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to handling restricted countries, the conventional options fall short. Stripe's lack of availability in many countries means you're forced to rely on workarounds or alternative payment processors. PayPal's account suspension policy can leave you vulnerable to funds being held for an extended period. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is specifically designed to operate in countries where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. With a sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can deploy your commerce stack in 48 hours, regardless of your location, and start selling ebooks online without relying on centralized services.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed, fees, and real costs are crucial considerations when choosing a payment processor. Stripe's fees range from 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction, while PayPal charges a flat fee of 3.5% + 30¢ per sale. Gumroad's fees are 3.5% + 30¢, and lemon squeezy charges a flat fee of 5% per sale. In contrast, NOWPayments, the payment processor used in the Edge Commerce Stack, charges a low fee of 0.5% with no buyer account required. This means you can keep more of your earnings and focus on growing your business.
With a sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can say goodbye to payment restrictions and hello to a future where you're in control.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership, automation, and delivery are key aspects of a successful ecommerce business. With conventional options, you're often forced to rely on third-party services, which can limit your control and flexibility. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership and control over your commerce stack, allowing you to automate payment processing, product delivery, and order management. This means you can focus on growing your business, without being held back by limitations imposed by centralized services.
